manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the white desk fan and set it on the Red mat facing the robot.

Task description: Place the white table fan on the red square mat currently to its left, with the fan's front facing the robot.

Success criteria: Place the fan near the red mat's center with its base on the mat, normally upright and its airflow face toward the robot. Both grippers must be open and release it.

## Execution tips

- Prefer the solid support section connecting the base to the fan head. Find a point with pad contact space on both sides, avoiding the thin grille bars, blades, and movable joint.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected grasp section. Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides, rather than appearing to enclose it in the image while being blocked by the wider mesh guard.
- Use the projecting rear motor housing to distinguish front from back during orientation adjustment. Lift the base off the table and leave rotation clearance around the grille edge to avoid dragging the red mat or sweeping the tabletop.
- During placement, let the base touch the mat gently and release only after it is securely supported, avoiding a tip from releasing with only one side of the base in contact.
